page: UpCloud PREMIUM-2xCPU-4GB is a Premium family virtual server configured with 2 shared vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, running on the KVM hypervisor. The underlying hardware features an AMD EPYC 9575F x86_64 processor operating at 2.0 GHz, with 2 physical cores and a single thread per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache. Storage is provided via a bundled 50 GB local SSD, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates highly polarized performance characteristics. Single-core CPU performance is exceptionally strong, with stress-ng single-core CPU tests, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression all placing in the top tier (top 10%). Geekbench single-core metrics also rank in the top 25%. However, multi-core and memory performance are significantly more limited. Multi-core Geekbench scores, software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks fall into the bottom 25%. Furthermore, the PassMark memory score ranks in the bottom 10%, and small-block read-only memory bandwidth is in the bottom 25%.

Given the shared CPU allocation and low memory capacity, this server offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads that do not require dedicated physical resources. It is well-suited for single-threaded utility tasks, lightweight static web serving, basic text processing, and prompt processing or text generation using small language models. It is less suitable for database operations, multi-threaded compilation, or memory-intensive applications due to the documented bottlenecks in memory bandwidth and multi-core scaling.
